programmes.d: The Teletubbies are very happy and have fun jumping all over Teletubbyland. The Teletubbies watch some children jumping. Tinky Winky makes up a dance.
Children visit a level crossing and watch a train; animals march through Teletubbyland.

Dipsy is out for a walk when a strong wind blows his hat away. The hat disappears into Home Hill, but Dipsy doesn't know where it has gone. Noo Noo blows the hat back out of Home Hill to Dipsy, who is very happy.
Slide game; Becky and Jed look for eggs on their farm; the lion and bear play hide-and-seek.

The Noo-noo wakes up the Teletubbies to watch some children paint a huge mural using spray paints. Laa-Laa is making Tubby Custard, but the Tubby Custard machine makes a big Tubby Custard squirt on Tinky Winky, Dipsy, Po and Laa-Laa.
Alex Pascall and some children sing to their dolls to rock them to sleep
Laa-Laa and Dipsy hug and run off to watch some children making some fancy dress clothes. A crown appears in Teletubbyland and when Tinky Winky wears the crown he becomes King Tinky Winky.
Tinky Winky doesn't know how to make Tubby Custard.
A voice trumpet rises to announce the colour purple. Some children explore the colours purple. In Teletubbyland a big beautiful purple flower grows.
Laa-Laa dances with her ball; living in a block of flats; balloon.
The Teletubbies watch some children play with balls of different shapes and sizes. In Teletubbyland, something happens to Dipsy's hat.
The Teletubbies imitate children doing funny walks before attempting funny walks of their own.
A voice trumpet brings a message that makes Laa-Laa laugh. The Teletubbies watch some children learning about the number one. The Teletubbies take turns to wear the skirt.
The Teletubbies line up to say 'Eh-oh' and then watch Matthew and Mark feed a baby calf.
The Teletubbies watch some children learn about number eight. Eight clouds appear in Teletubbyland and the Teletubbies learn count to eight. The animals march through Teletubbyland.

The Teletubbies watch some children exploring the colour red. Po makes some adjustments on the switch panel and all the lights change to the colour red. Po sees some red clouds and changes the colour of all the flowers to red.
Dipsy's hat keeps blowing away and he has to chase it all over Teletubbyland.
Laa-Laa dances with her ball. A little boy tells us why he likes to live in his block of flats. A balloon appears in Teletubbyland. The Teletubbies follow a balloon.
Some children help their dad to wash his car. They get very wet and soapy.
A voice trumpet rises to teach the Teletubbies the rhyme ‘How Now Brown Cow’. The Teletubbies watch some children explore the colour brown.
The Tubbies crawl through the arch in Home Hill and watch Alex Pascall and some children sing...

Tinky Winky plays a there and back game on the path. Some children visit a clog shop and watch some clogs being made. They try some on and find they are very noisy. Laa-Laa goes for a walk, but outside it is raining. So Laa-Laa walks indoors.
The Teletubbies watch some children play with balls of different shapes and sizes.

The Tubbies laugh when laugh when they bump into each other and fall over. They all watch two girls meet Tito a Flamenco guitar player who plays them a nursery rhyme. A guitar appears in Teletubbyland.
It's time for the Teletubbies to exercise; a voice trumpet rises and the Teletubbies stretch.
The Teletubbies pass over a hill, one by one to say “Eh-oh”. They watch three boys making an obstacle course. In Teletubbyland, it’s time for the Teletubbies to go to bed.
The Teletubbies watch some children learn about the number two.
A voice trumpet appears and the Teletubbies play a round and round game. They watch some children playing stop and go. Then they play a Ready, Steady, Go game round and round Home Hill.
The Teletubbies dance a jumping dance before stopping to watch Yvette wash up her plastic cups and saucers. The Teletubbies have a very messy day. So Noo-Noo has to tidy everything up.
The animals march through Teletubbyland.
The Teletubbies watch a little boy called Brennan pretend to fly to the moon. In Teletubbyland, the Teletubbies are going out to play.
Amy cooks pasta at home; Noo-Noo cleans up an unraveled ball of string.
The Teletubbies run across the hills to say "Eh-oh" and watch some children playing tennis. Laa-Laa and Po love to play with the ball. They roll, throw and kick it to each other.
Another story about the Naughty Sock; the Tubby toast machine makes a pile of toast.
A voice trumpet appears and teaches the Teletubbies a winter nursery rhyme. Po’s present is a little frosty cloud that begins to snow.
The Teletubbies watch some children looking at penguins waddling and swimming.
A voice trumpet rises and the Teletubbies run out of the house to listen to the Woof Woof sounds. The Teletubbies copy the sounds again and again.
In Teletubbyland, nine pretty flowers and a watering can appear.
Tinky Winky fetches the others to watch two little boys making bread. They kneed the dough and once it is baked they eat the bread with jam.
The Teletubbies love playing on the slide.
The Teletubbies watch a little girl draw a picture on a paving slab using chalks. A cloud appears in Teletubbyland and rains and rains and makes a big beautiful rainbow.
The Teletubbies learn gymnastic routines from Samira and her friends.
The Tubbies love to dance. They watch some children perform in a Ballet Show. Dipsy dances in his bed and Laa-Laa dances whilst making Tubby Custard.
The number four with Noo Noo; Po draws an oval; black and white; a boy and a girl help milk a cow.
Dipsy makes bouncy Tubby Toast. It bounces all around Home Hill. The Teletubbies watch two children make an apple pie. Bo Peep appears in Teletubbyland looking for her lost sheep.
It's time for the Teletubbies to do their exercises. A voice trumpet rises and the Teletubbies stretch up and down to it's instructions.
Maribel teaches flamenco dancing to two eager students; the Teletubbies wash their feet.
Laa-Laa says "Eh-oh" and then runs off to join the others watch some children learn about the number ten. The Teletubbies love to play games.
The Teletubbies laugh when they make a tune whilst eating their Tubby Custard.
The Teletubbies watch Brian Cant read a story to some children. In Teletubbyland, somebody spilled the Tubby Custard, made a mess with their Tubby Toast at the control panel, and fell fast asleep.
Tinky Winky dance on the roof of Home Hill and wakes up the other Tubbies.
The Teletubbies watch some children sharing a story about a robot. Po wakes up after the other Teletubbies and does everything on her own.
Dipsy says "Eh-oh" and runs off to find the other Tubbies.
A voice trumpet brings a magical sound for the Teletubbies. The Teletubbies watch some children take their dog and a ball to the beach.
The Tubbies watch a little girl who loves monkeys help her mum feed them in a zoo.
Po fetches the others to watch some girls perform an Indian dance. In Teletubbyland, Dipsy dances a very special dance. Dipsy showed Tinky Winky his very special dance.
The Teletubbies are very happy when they find their favourite things to play with.

The Teletubbies play 'Boo', but stop to watch Ned help his dad plant and water some geraniums. In Teletubbyland, nine pretty flowers and a watering can appear, but Laa-Laa and Dipsy can't decide who should water them.
In Teletubbyland, the Tubbies are trying to be quiet.
A voice trumpet rises to play some double bass music for Laa-Laa. The Tubbies watch some children visit their friend who plays the double bass.
Po fetches the other to watch Andy Brown and two children look for some rabbits.
The Teletubbies dance before watching some children wrapping presents for their friend. The Noo Noo tidies up the Teletubbies blankets, while the Tubbies are still in bed.
Dancing; children paint pictures and patterns on eggs; magical tree appears.
Dipsy fetches the others to watch Andy Brown and some children looking at Peacocks. The magical tree appears in Teletubbyland.
Tinky Winky, Dipsy and Laa-Laa sit down to eat some Tubby Custard.
The Teletubbies find each other for a big hug before watching a little girl read her sister a story that she has written and illustrated herself. It’s called ‘The Girl In The Back Garden’.

The Teletubbies watch a little boy show us how to make a Turban. The Tubbies go for a walk, but Po, Laa-Laa and Dipsy want to play with their favourite things, so Tinky Winky goes for a walk on his own – all the way home.
Boy makes a turban; Dipsy, Po and Laalaa play; Tinky Winky goes for a walk.

The Teletubbies leave their favourite things to watch some boys spinning some spinning tops to celebrate the Hanukah festival. Tinky Winky wears the skirt on his head to do a very special round and round dance.
Becky goes on a tram ride and has an accident involving Po's scooter.

The Tubbies bump tummies and then watch five girls dance a Kathak dance. The Teletubbies play a game and swap their favourite things, but they are very happy when they each have their own special favourite things back.
The Tubbies watch some children are playing football in the park.
The Teletubbies play a hiding game, Dipsy shuts his eyes and the other Tubbies hide from him. But Dipsy can't find them, so the Noo Noo helps him.
Tamzin Griffin pretends to be the Funny Lady; LaaLaa dances a secret dance.
The Teletubbies watch Andy Brown and some children looking for Grasshoppers. In Teletubbyland the Teletubbies are jumping over different things.
Tinky Winky finds Po sleeping in his bed; Andy Brown looks for snails.
All four Teletubbies stride across Teletubbyland to say hello. The Teletubbies watch a little girl take her rabbit to the vet.
The Teletubbies learn about the number three just before three boats go sailing by.
The Teletubbies watch some children who have a barrel organ. A man turns the handle and the children dance. A musical box appears.
A voice trumpet sounds while the Teletubbies sleep; a lion and bear come to Teletubbyland.

Noo-Noo tidies up Home hill before the Teletubbies slide up the slide to watch Natalie tell us about her brother's christening. A magic cloud with magic powers rains special magic flowers all over Teletubbyland.
Noo-Noo drives fast; children make a salad; dancing bear on the carousel.
The Teletubbies watch some children hanging out their washing. Tinky Winky, Laa-Laa and Po are out walking together when a clothes line appears.
The Teletubbies watch two boys make Chinese Lanterns with their uncle.
Laa-Laa is playing indoors with her ball, the Noo Noo catches it and tidies it up. Laa-Laa chases the Noo Noo till she gets her ball back.
Children learn about all things green; the Teletubbies pick Dipsy as their favorite green thing.
The Teletubbies watch some children learn about the number three. Tinky Winky, Dipsy and Laa-Laa go for a walk. They count three trees and three flowers and Po follows behind counting too.
A voice trumpet brings a message for Dipsy and Laa-Laa which makes them laugh and run away. The Teletubbies watch some children dancing with King Pleasure and the Biscuit Boys.
The Teletubbies and some children learn about the colour blue.

Po wants some Tubby Custard, but she doesn' t have time to eat is before watching some children do some painting in the garden. The Tubbies are very careful not to spill their Tubby Custard, but if they do, the Noo Noo will tidy up.
Natalie tells the Teletubbies about her brother's christening; magic cloud.
The Teletubbies are feeling very happy. They run and dance around cheering and hugging. They stop to watch some children in South Africa looking at monkeys.
The Teletubbies watch Sarah and Mark give their sheep a winter-feed.

The Teletubbies watch three boys fill a sand pendulum and make a picture. Tinky Winky, Dipsy and Laa-Laa follow Po everywhere. The animals march through Teletubbyland, before it is time for Tubby Bye-Bye.
The Teletubbies watch boys spin some special spinning tops to celebrate Hanukah.
The Teletubbies watch Thomas and Jack having fun playing on the beach and building sandcastles. In Teletubbyland the Teletubbies are going round and round.
The Teletubbies dance; Yvette washes her plastic cups and saucers; messy day.
A little girl uses different things to stick a face onto a pumpkin. A pumpkin appears in Teletubbyland. It has two ears, a nose, two eyes and a big smile.
The Teletubbies are asleep, but Noo-Noo tidies up their blankets.
The Teletubbies watch two boys make models of heads out of clay. Dipsy is very pleased with himself when he discovers his eyes, mouth, nose and ears.
